summary: Split the gpt-copy-v8 greenfield monorepo into 14 scoped tasks across root hygiene, backend foundation, backend provider/persistence routes, frontend foundation, frontend chat UI, focused tests, Playwright smoke coverage, and final verification. The graph keeps OpenRouter server-side, uses mocked provider behavior in automated tests, declares explicit wave dependencies, and ends with backend, frontend, documentation, and secret-scan gates.

proposals.title: Backend-first API contract with parallel frontend scaffold
proposals.summary: Build the Axum/sqlx backend foundation and the Next.js/Tailwind frontend foundation in the same wave, then let API schemas and UI work proceed from the documented JSON/SSE contract.

proposals.title: Mockable OpenRouter boundary
proposals.summary: Introduce an OpenRouter trait and deterministic mock before message routes so backend tests cover success, streaming, 429, timeout, invalid response, and interrupted stream behavior without external provider calls.

proposals.title: Frontend QA isolated from live services
proposals.summary: Use Vitest component tests and Playwright route mocks to verify the chat UI, composer behavior, conversation state, and streamed assistant output without requiring a live backend or OpenRouter quota.

risks.title: OpenRouter leakage into frontend or tests
risks.impact: Provider keys or quota-dependent calls could violate project rules and make automated verification unsafe.
risks.mitigation: Keep all OpenRouter code in backend only, use OPENROUTER_API_KEY only in backend runtime config, and require provider mocks in all automated tests.

risks.title: SSE persistence and disconnect behavior
risks.impact: Streaming could emit tokens but fail to persist assistant messages, or interrupted streams could crash handlers.
risks.mitigation: Separate stream token emission from final persistence, test completed streams and upstream interruption paths, and emit structured SSE error events.

risks.title: Frontend/backend contract drift
risks.impact: UI hooks, Playwright mocks, and backend JSON/SSE payloads may diverge and break end-to-end behavior late.
risks.mitigation: Define zod schemas and shared route expectations early, align mocked Playwright responses with backend shapes, and run full backend and frontend gates before handoff.

risks.title: Generated artifacts committed
risks.impact: SQLite databases, build outputs, node_modules, or test reports could pollute the repository and violate rules.
risks.mitigation: Handle root ignore rules in the first task and repeat git status plus tracked-file checks in final verification.

claims.title: Use independent foundation tracks
claims.summary: Root hygiene, backend foundation, and frontend foundation are separated so backend and frontend workers can proceed in parallel after repository guardrails exist.

claims.title: Provider calls stay server-side
claims.summary: Only backend runtime code may call OpenRouter; frontend code talks exclusively to the Axum API and automated tests use mocks.

claims.title: Treat SSE as a first-class backend contract
claims.summary: The backend owns token, done, and error SSE frames, while the frontend owns parsing, abort handling, and UI streaming state.

claims.title: Completion depends on verification and review
claims.summary: Final reports must not claim completion until backend verification, frontend verification, Playwright smoke coverage, secret scanning, and CodeDungeon review gates pass.

tasks.title: Root guardrails and environment placeholders
tasks.objective: Prepare monorepo hygiene, placeholder environment documentation, and artifact ignores before implementation workers create backend and frontend outputs.
context: Project rules require .env ignored, .env.example placeholder-only, and no committed secrets or generated artifacts.
OPENROUTER_MODEL must default to nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free when no local override exists.
This task must not add any real OpenRouter key or machine-local configuration.
acceptance_criteria: .gitignore excludes .env, backend SQLite databases, backend/target, frontend/node_modules, frontend/.next, frontend/test-results, frontend/playwright-report, and common logs.
.env.example contains placeholder-only OPENROUTER_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_MODEL, DATABASE_URL, BACKEND_HOST, BACKEND_PORT, FRONTEND_ORIGIN, and NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL values.
README preserves the gpt-copy-v8 ChatGPT-style scope and includes provisional setup, run, and test sections without claiming completion.
risk_notes: A placeholder variable name may appear in secret scans; real key material must not.
Do not mark the project complete from this documentation task.

tasks.title: Rust Axum foundation
tasks.objective: Create the Rust 2024 Axum backend crate with configuration, shared state, structured errors, CORS, health route, and test harness.
context: Backend must live under backend/ and use Rust 2024 with Axum.
Runtime configuration must read OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_MODEL server-side only.
OPENROUTER_MODEL default is nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free.
acceptance_criteria: backend/Cargo.toml uses edition 2024 and includes Axum, Tokio, Serde, tower-http, thiserror, tracing, sqlx, uuid, chrono, reqwest, async-stream or tokio-stream, and test dependencies as needed.
GET /health returns structured JSON with status ok and backend version.
AppError maps validation, not found, upstream, database, and internal failures to stable JSON error responses.
CORS allows the configured FRONTEND_ORIGIN without exposing provider secrets.
risk_notes: Configuration tests must not require a real OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
Do not log Authorization headers or raw provider secrets.

tasks.title: SQLite schema and repository helpers
tasks.objective: Add SQLite migrations and focused database helper functions for conversations and messages.
context: Backend persistence must use SQLite with sqlx.
The app needs conversations and messages persisted across restarts.
Workers should prefer runtime checked sqlx queries unless offline query metadata is explicitly configured.
acceptance_criteria: Migration creates conversations and messages tables with UUID text ids, timestamps, roles, content, and foreign key cascade from messages to conversations.
Database initialization runs migrations and enables SQLite foreign keys.
Repository helpers can create/list conversations, create/list messages, update conversation timestamps, and reject missing conversation ids.
Database tests use temporary SQLite files or in-memory databases and do not create tracked database artifacts.
risk_notes: SQLite in-memory databases can disappear across pooled connections; configure tests deliberately.
Timestamp ordering must be deterministic enough for list assertions.

tasks.title: OpenRouter client boundary
tasks.objective: Implement a mockable OpenRouter client abstraction, HTTP implementation, streaming parser, and provider failure tests.
context: OpenRouter calls must stay server-side.
Automated tests must not call external providers unless explicitly required by the user.
Project rules require graceful handling of 429, timeout, invalid response, and interrupted stream errors.
acceptance_criteria: A trait or interface exposes non-streaming chat and streaming chat methods using backend message history and configured model.
The HTTP implementation sends bearer-authenticated requests to OpenRouter chat completions endpoints without leaking key material.
The stream parser handles data frames, content deltas, data: [DONE], malformed JSON, upstream status errors, timeouts, and interrupted streams.
Mock provider support lets route tests return deterministic responses and injected failures.
risk_notes: Do not place OPENROUTER_API_KEY in frontend files or test snapshots.
Provider failure tests should use mocks or local test servers only.

tasks.title: Next.js app foundation
tasks.objective: Create the Next.js 15 App Router TypeScript frontend with Tailwind, linting, Vitest, Playwright configuration, and a usable app entry point.
context: Frontend must live under frontend/ and use Next.js 15 App Router, TypeScript, and Tailwind.
The first screen should be the chat application shell, not a marketing landing page.
Frontend environment must use NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL only and must not reference OpenRouter keys.
acceptance_criteria: package.json includes scripts for dev, build, lint, test, test:e2e, and test:e2e:install.
TypeScript strict mode and @/* path alias are configured.
Tailwind styles load through App Router globals and the root page renders a placeholder ChatShell mount.
Playwright webServer starts the frontend dev server on port 3000 or a documented alternate port.
risk_notes: Next.js 15 lint setup may require flat ESLint config rather than legacy next lint.
Do not commit frontend/node_modules or .next outputs.

tasks.title: Conversation REST API
tasks.objective: Add conversation list and create endpoints with validation, persistence, ordering, and route tests.
context: Endpoints are GET /api/conversations and POST /api/conversations.
Conversation titles must be non-empty and bounded.
Responses must be stable for frontend zod schemas.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/conversations returns an empty array for a new database and conversations ordered by updated_at descending after inserts.
POST /api/conversations returns 201 with id, title, created_at, and updated_at.
Invalid empty or too-long titles return 400 with a structured validation error.
Route tests prove persistence and validation behavior without provider calls.
risk_notes: Keep JSON field names stable because frontend schemas will depend on them.
Do not overbuild update/delete endpoints unless required by downstream tasks.

tasks.title: Frontend API schemas and hooks
tasks.objective: Create typed zod schemas, API fetch helpers, query hooks, and a native SSE streaming hook for the backend contract.
context: Frontend talks only to the Axum API.
SSE frames should support token, done, and error events.
The API base URL defaults to http://localhost:8080 through NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL.
acceptance_criteria: Schemas cover health, conversation, message, send response, SSE done payload, and structured backend error bodies.
apiFetch validates responses with zod and throws a typed ApiError for structured backend errors.
Query hooks use stable keys for conversations and messages.
The streaming hook supports abort, token accumulation, done invalidation, and structured error handling.
risk_notes: SSE parsing must handle chunks that split event frames across reads.
Do not use OpenRouter environment names in frontend code.

tasks.title: Message REST and SSE API
tasks.objective: Add message listing, non-streaming send, and streaming send endpoints with persistence, provider integration, validation, and failure behavior.
context: Depends on SQLite repository helpers, conversation routes, and mockable OpenRouter client.
Endpoints are GET /api/conversations/:id/messages, POST /api/conversations/:id/messages, and POST /api/conversations/:id/stream.
Message content must be non-empty and bounded.
acceptance_criteria: GET messages returns messages sorted by created_at ascending and returns 404 for missing conversations.
POST messages persists the user message, calls the provider mock or client server-side, persists the assistant message, and returns both messages.
POST stream emits token events, emits done with persisted assistant metadata, updates conversation timestamps, and stores the concatenated assistant response on completion.
429, timeout, invalid response, and interrupted stream cases return structured JSON or SSE error events without panics.
risk_notes: Do not hold a database transaction open while streaming tokens to the client.
Interrupted streams should be observable as errors and must not leave corrupt persisted records.

tasks.title: ChatGPT-style interface
tasks.objective: Build the usable chat interface with sidebar conversations, active transcript, composer, streaming assistant state, markdown rendering, and responsive mobile behavior.
context: Use App Router page as the application screen.
Use lucide-react icons where suitable for controls.
Use react-markdown and remark-gfm for assistant markdown without raw HTML.
acceptance_criteria: Sidebar lists conversations, highlights the active item with aria-current, and exposes a new chat action.
Active conversation state is represented in the URL query string using c=<conversation-id>.
Composer supports Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline, disabled sending while streaming, and accessible Message and Send controls.
Streaming assistant text appears incrementally and final messages are refreshed through query invalidation.
The layout is responsive with no horizontal overflow or overlapping text on mobile and desktop.
risk_notes: Avoid visible instructional marketing copy; the first screen should be the app itself.
Keep styling balanced and not dominated by a single purple, beige, or dark-blue palette.

tasks.title: Frontend component tests
tasks.objective: Add focused Vitest and Testing Library coverage for message rendering, composer behavior, and sidebar conversation state.
context: Component tests should avoid real backend calls.
Use fresh QueryClient instances or direct component props to prevent shared state leakage.
Tests should assert user-observable behavior rather than implementation details.
acceptance_criteria: MessageBubble tests cover user/assistant rendering, markdown emphasis or list rendering, and streaming indicator state.
Composer tests cover Enter submit, Shift+Enter newline, empty input disabled behavior, and disabled state while streaming.
Sidebar tests cover conversation list rendering, empty state, new chat action, and active aria-current.
Vitest passes in jsdom without backend or OpenRouter access.
risk_notes: Mock network boundaries rather than the browser Fetch API globally unless necessary.
Use accessible labels to keep tests aligned with usable UI behavior.

tasks.title: Playwright mocked streaming smoke
tasks.objective: Add a Playwright smoke test that opens the app, creates a conversation, sends a message, and verifies mocked streamed assistant output.
context: The smoke test must not require a live backend or OpenRouter.
Route mocks must match the frontend API base URL and be registered before page navigation.
The test should exercise the actual UI path, not internal hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Playwright intercepts health, conversations, messages, and stream routes with deterministic mocked responses.
The test fills the Message composer, sends text, observes streamed assistant content, and verifies the final assistant message.
The URL includes c=<mock-conversation-id> after conversation creation or selection.
The test fails on uncaught page errors and unexpected browser console errors.
risk_notes: Browser installation may be unavailable in constrained environments; report that as a verification blocker rather than claiming pass.
Mock stream framing must match backend SSE event names and payload shapes.

tasks.title: Backend full verification
tasks.objective: Run and stabilize backend formatting, clippy, all tests, and release build after backend implementation tasks are complete.
context: This is the backend verification gate required by approved project rules.
Failures should be fixed in backend-owned files without weakening required behavior.
Tests must still avoid real OpenRouter calls.
acceptance_criteria: cargo fmt --check passes for backend.
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings passes for backend.
cargo test passes for backend without external provider calls.
cargo build --release succeeds for backend.
risk_notes: Do not silence clippy by allowing warnings globally.
If tests create SQLite files, ensure they are ignored and not tracked.

tasks.title: Frontend full verification
tasks.objective: Run and stabilize frontend install, linting, component tests, production build, and mocked Playwright smoke coverage after frontend implementation tasks are complete.
context: This is the frontend verification gate required by approved project rules.
Playwright remains mocked and must not require the backend server or OpenRouter.
Failures should be fixed in frontend-owned files without weakening required behavior.
acceptance_criteria: npm install completes with package-lock.json generated if npm is the chosen package manager.
npm run lint passes.
npm run test passes.
npm run build passes with no TypeScript errors.
npm run test:e2e passes with mocked API routes and no external provider calls.
risk_notes: Do not commit frontend/node_modules, .next, test-results, or playwright-report.
If Playwright browser installation is blocked, report the blocker explicitly rather than claiming pass.

tasks.title: Final docs, secret scan, and handoff
tasks.objective: Finalize README accuracy, confirm ignored artifacts, scan tracked files for provider secrets, and prepare PR-centered CodeDungeon handoff readiness.
context: This task depends on backend and frontend verification gates.
Final CodeDungeon reports may claim completion only when verification is PASS and review is APPROVED.
Project rules status, digest, and read flags must appear in final reports.
acceptance_criteria: README accurately documents setup, environment variables, backend run, frontend run, backend verification, frontend verification, and Playwright smoke commands.
.env.example remains placeholder-only and preserves the required OPENROUTER_MODEL default.
Tracked-file secret scan finds no real OpenRouter key material, tokens, or bearer credentials.
git status shows no generated databases, node_modules, build outputs, or test reports staged or tracked.
Final handoff includes project rules status approved, digest 54eae19e90a1b403912baee95e0294f1ff7bdf2aff6afb8d07af8d0744677dfe, read yes.
risk_notes: The secret scan command may need manual review if it matches placeholder variable names; real secrets are a failure.
Do not merge; keep the workflow PR-centered and leave final merge to the user.
